items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and sensitive.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, well-moisturized skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily sunscreen for fair, easily reddened skin.

response.routine_note: Persistent flushing, bumps and gritty eyes are best looked at by a dermatologist or eye doctor rather than by a stronger product, so we have kept this to gentle basics and left out exfoliating acids, retinoids and scrubs that could add to the irritation. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, with the sunscreen last each morning.
